quests.title: Tea or Bulle Fruit?

dialogue.t: Please accept my gratitude, Miss Sandrone, on behalf of Miss Mamere, for your kind invitation.
Mmhmm, this food is delicious. Thank you, Sandrone. Your culinary skills are amazing!
But Prototype 4ACV07, I believe this is the first time we've met? How did you recognize me?
Whoa, that's the first time I've heard anyone call Seymour that...
Affirmative. Although I am familiar with your gentleness and radiance, I have never seen you in the flesh before, Miss Sandrone.
I can recognize you because your appearance is an exact match of my master, Miss Mary-Ann Guillotin. Her image is permanently recorded in my memory unit.
Miss Mary-Ann told me about you. Since your appearance matches hers, the logical reasoning required to recognize you is quite simple, Miss Sandrone.
Hah, even Alain's earliest work is so impressive. Though it appears you've had a few enhancements made... I suppose I should address you as Seymour now?
Were you confused when you saw me?
Negative. My primary directive is to accompany and protect Miss Mary-Ann on behalf of Alain Guillotin.
As such, my knowledge of Miss Mary-Ann is complete. And based on a logical analysis of finite-dimensional vector spaces, you and Miss Mary-Ann are totally different, Miss Sandrone.
Like the difference between the tea leaves of Chenyu Vale and the Beryl Region's Bulle Fruit.
Is Sandrone the tea or the Bulle Fruit?
Searching... Insufficient data. Unable to answer.
(*sigh*... I'm glad Alain improved his language module design by the time he created me.)

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Huh!? So soon? Thank you, Miss Sandrone! I hope to see you next time!

quests.description: Go to the viewing deck in Nasha Town, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests…
